# Trods optur i Mærsk-aktie: Derfor er investorer kritiske

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-09-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish/Nordic episode centers on the ten-year transformation of AP Møller Mærsk into a transport-and-logistics group, with both studio guests skeptical that it has proven itself as more than a cyclical shipping play. Other themes include a possible AI market bubble versus a continuing US tech-driven bull market, a review of three summer Danish IPOs (Biomar, Bar Juice, Installatørgruppen), the Audientes bankruptcy/police probe, and All Star portfolio positions. Overall mood is mixed — bullish on select US tech/AI and quality names, but critical of Mærsk, recent small-cap IPOs and speculative froth.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ MAERSK-B — AP Møller Mærsk | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Both guests uninterested: cyclical shipping economics, ROIC ~4% below ~7%+ cost of capital over 14 yrs; earnings driven by one-off Covid boom.

#### Reasoning

Peter and Ole both decline the stock: ROIC has averaged only ~4% over 14 years, below cost of capital, with the two Covid years flattering returns. Market still reads it as a shipping play, the 6% logistics-margin target is unmet, and freight rates are expected to fall as new capacity arrives. Too many variables (freight rates, FX, oil) with no track record of value creation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if logistics division proves it can stabilize earnings through a shipping downturn
- if the 6% margin target is credibly hit
- if a capital markets day reframes strategy convincingly

> *"Jag är heller inte intresserad av sällskapet. Det är en cyklisk business. ... det långsiktiga avkastet på investerad kapital är under 10% så däcker det ju inte deras egen kapitalomkostning."*

---

### 🟡 CHEMM — Chemometec | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Up >100% since March; new Roche connection-kit deal, new products, CFO change; Peter loves the business and wants to keep it.

#### Reasoning

Peter argues the only prior problem was valuation (expensive at 700, a buy at 249 after the profit warning). From here the newsflow is interesting — Roche connection-kit deal widely noticed (Fundamental Invest wrote it up), plus new products selling well. He wants to keep the position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Roche deal fails to translate into product sales
- if valuation re-inflates without earnings

> *"Jag tror egentligen härifrån att den är nyhetsmässigt intressant nog. ... Så jag syns vi ska behålla den."*

---

### 🟡 COLO-B — Coloplast | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Held from 460, now 370; kept Q3 guidance, 5-6% growth, EBIT-margin lift and Atos/Coracis synergies expected; JP Morgan cut to sell but Peter thinks it has turned.

#### Reasoning

Despite the drop from 460 and a JP Morgan downgrade to sell, Peter believes the stock has bottomed fundamentally: Q3 guidance held against downgrade fears, ~5-6% top/bottom-line growth, and margin expansion plus synergies from the Atos and Coracis acquisitions ahead. Foundation-ownership change does not alter the case.

#### Sell Triggers

- if synergies from Atos/Coracis fail to materialize
- if margin expansion stalls
- if growth falls below the 5-6% range

> *"Jag tror egentligen också att den har vänt. Fundamentalt. Ja, det tror jag."*

---

### 🟢 UBER — Uber | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Ole re-invested; CEO bought $5.5m of stock, recent reports confirm strong cash flow; was 60→90, now ~73.

#### Reasoning

Ole has already re-bought Uber. Two positives: the CEO just bought $5.5m of stock (a positive signal), and recent reports confirm cash flow is running well. Previously a top-performer in the S&P 500 (60→90) before pulling back to ~73, offering a re-entry.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cash flow generation deteriorates in coming reports
- if insider buying reverses

> *"igår så köpte CEO, han köpte för 5,5 miljoner dollar till sig själv. Vilket är en rätt positiv tegn. De senaste rapporterna bekräftar bara att cashflow det kör."*

---

### 🟢 BIOMAR — Biomar | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Best of the three summer IPOs; raised sales guidance to 17-18bn soon after listing, +19% from IPO price — 'super approved'.

#### Reasoning

Biomar delivered exactly what investors want: an upward guidance revision (to 17-18bn from 16-17bn) shortly after its listing and a 19% gain from the IPO price. Both guests agree the listing is 'more than approved'. Monitors South American water-temperature risk to production.

#### Sell Triggers

- if abnormal South American water temperatures hurt production
- if subsequent guidance is cut

> *"Biomar har ju levererat precis det man kan önska sig som en väster. De kommer ut med en uppjustering till börsmarknaden ganska kort tid efter att de har gått på."*

---

### 🟢 SYDB — AL Sydbank | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Best 5-yr return among larger Danish banks (420%); post-merger synergies of 1.2bn/yr could lift EPS from ~50-55 to over 70 kr.

#### Reasoning

Simon highlights AL Sydbank's 420% five-year total return, beating all larger Danish banks. Following the December merger with Vestjysk Bank and Arbejdernes Landsbank, management targets 1.2bn kr of annual synergies over two years, which could raise EPS from ~50-55 to over 70 kr — supporting further upside, though much depends on rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the 1.2bn synergy target is not realized over two years
- if interest-rate levels fall sharply

> *"om de kan genomföra dem över de nästa två åren så förväntar man sig att intjäningen per aktie kan stiga från omkring 50-55 kronor till upp mot över 70 kronor per aktie."*

---

### 🟡 VWS — Vestas | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Delivered +25% incl. dividend this year in the All Star portfolio; Ole trimmed half to cash to redeploy into weakness later.

#### Reasoning

Vestas has returned +25% including dividend this year. Ole took half the position to cash — not because he dislikes it, but to build dry powder ahead of a seasonally weak vacuum period, planning to redeploy into Q3 reporting (from ~10-12 October) which he expects to be strong.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 reports disappoint versus expectation of strong results
- if seasonal weakness deepens materially

> *"Vestas har i invända år givit plus 25 procent, så vill jag veta, inklusive utbytet."*

---

### 🟡 NETC — Netcompany | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

In All Star portfolio; Ole cut it to half cash, describing the stock as lagging / 'in the brakes'.

#### Reasoning

Ole reduced Netcompany to half cash as part of raising dry powder before a weak seasonal window, describing the stock as 'hanging in the brakes'. Neutral-to-cautious stance rather than outright negative, awaiting the Q3 reporting season he expects to be strong.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 results underwhelm
- if the stock continues to lag peers

> *"Så du har sålt positionen ned till halva. Alltså i Netcompany och Vestas."*
